title: Add commit-pr-narrative skill to the harness canonical skills
refined_problem: The harness has pr-creation (PR structure and model routing) and work-unit-commits (small coherent units), but no skill that mandates the full narrative a reviewer and future readers need: what was done, how, why, alternatives rejected, trade-offs, and the evidence behind the claim. The owner wants commit/PR storytelling as a first-class part of the flow, with professional best practices, without duplicating existing skills.

original_request.text: grea un agente o skill para ahcer los mejores commit y pr, explicando que se realizo y como y porque, bien detallado y con las buenas practicas y esta skill agregalas al fluj, tambien agregagentes que crean que hagan falta y con esto subimos todo

target_users: Reviewers and future readers auditing history
The repository owner building a professional portfolio
outcomes: A canonical, portable skill commit-pr-narrative committed under .agents/skills/ and compiled into provider providers adapters
Every routed task's final commit and PR narrative explains what was done, how, why and with which evidence
success_metrics: harness smoke tests still pass with the new skill registered

in: Create canonical skill .agents/skills/commit-pr-narrative/SKILL.md with frontmatter, when-to-use, narrative contract, commit message contract, PR body contract, failure modes and anti-patterns
out: Changes to task_router, gates, policies or evidence schemas

mvp.goal: One new canonical skill registered in the manifest and compiled, with narrative contracts delegating mechanics to work-unit-commits and pr-creation.
includes: Narrative sections: What was done / How it was done / Why this way (alternatives and trade-offs) / Evidence
Conventional Commits titles and scope-by-risk guidance
PR body aligned with pr-creation sections plus explicit how/why narrative
Anti-patterns: raw diffs, invented tests, secrets, huge mixed-purpose commits

assumptions: No new agents are warranted: the existing implementer/reviewer/verifier roster covers commit and PR authoring; adding agents would violate the no-ceremonial-agents policy
challenges: Manifest registration and generated adapters must be updated through scripts/compile_harness.py, never edited by hand

tasks.title: Author commit-pr-narrative canonical skill, register and compile
tasks.description: Create .agents/skills/commit-pr-narrative/SKILL.md (English, frontmatter name/description, sections: When to use, Relationship to existing skills, Commit narrative contract, Commit message contract, Pull request narrative contract, Best practices, Anti-patterns), register it in harness/manifest.yaml skills list, run scripts/compile_harness.py to regenerate provider adapters, and verify with scripts/compile_harness.py --check plus a focused smoke check that the skill is discoverable.
acceptance_criteria: .agents/skills/commit-pr-narrative/SKILL.md exists with valid YAML frontmatter (name, description) and the narrative sections agreed
The narrative contract requires What/How/Why (with rejected alternatives and trade-offs) and Evidence in every commit message body above trivial, and in every PR body
Mechanical guidance references work-unit-commits and pr-creation instead of duplicating them
python scripts/compile_harness.py regenerates provider adapters including the compiled wrapper for the new skill, and --check passes
Focused verification that the new skill name appears in the compiled artifacts

research_rdd.reason: Bounded documentation/config addition with all context available in-repo (two sibling skills provide the contract base).

recorded_decisions: skill-based solution instead of a new agent type (no ceremonial agents)
narrative layer separates from mechanical pr-creation and work-unit-commits skills
